text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I make my move, setting my sights on the 
Kobe Shimbun Hai. That said, haste is 
forbidden.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
O battlefield! O stage of departure! 
Farewell for now. With the June race 
ahead, we shall replenish our strength!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp is right around the 
corner. The blazing sun in the heavens 
awaits me!
